description: Summary figure: ADAMTSL1 domain architecture with pLDDT, Foldseek best hits per segment, ADAMTS13 exosite conservation, TSR charge/motif analysis
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mp

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Provenance: all numbers below were computed in this job from
#  - AF-Q8N6G6-F1-model_v6.pdb  (AlphaFold DB v6, 1762 aa, canonical isoform Q8N6G6-3)
#  - Foldseek web server (search.foldseek.com, 3Di+AA mode) vs pdb100 and afdb-swissprot
#  - UniProt Q8N6G6 / Q76LX8, InterPro match positions
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

dom = pd.DataFrame([
 ("Signal",1,28,32.8),("TSR1",33,82,75.8),("CysRich",103,185,84.3),("Spacer",188,296,83.8),
 ("TSR2",301,360,66.4),("TSR3",376,438,64.7),("TSR4",439,493,63.7),("linker",494,524,44.7),
 ("TSR5",525,584,75.6),("TSR6",610,667,76.1),("TSR7",668,729,77.6),("TSR8",732,789,76.8),
 ("TSR9",790,850,70.9),("Ig1",861,959,84.4),("low-conf 960-1070",960,1070,40.7),
 ("ADAMTSL1 dom",1071,1110,71.5),("disordered",1120,1164,34.1),("Ig2",1164,1272,77.8),
 ("Ig3",1285,1379,82.4),("Ig4",1392,1489,82.3),("TSR10",1490,1546,74.5),("TSR11",1547,1608,79.8),
 ("TSR12",1609,1667,80.0),("TSR13",1669,1726,76.3),("PLAC",1726,1762,58.2)],
 columns=["name","start","end","pLDDT"])

fs = pd.DataFrame([
 ("TSR1 (29-95)","1lsl_A  TSP-1 TSR2-3",3.812e-4,40.3),
 ("CysRich (96-187)","3ghm_A  ADAMTS13 DTCS",5.126e-4,32.6),
 ("Spacer (188-300)","3vn4_A  ADAMTS13 DTCS",8.331e-4,16.9),
 ("CysRich+Spacer (96-300)","3vn4_A  ADAMTS13 DTCS",1.181e-10,25.1),
 ("TSR2-TSR4 (301-500)","1lsl_A  TSP-1 TSR2-3",6.156e-4,20.6),
 ("TSR5-TSR9 (520-855)","1lsl_A  TSP-1 TSR2-3",1.939e-4,23.4),
 ("Ig1 (855-965)","2eo1_A  obscurin Ig",1.239e-6,22.5),
 ("ADAMTSL1 dom (1040-1120)","3stq_F  (no real hit)",5.007,11.9),
 ("Ig2-Ig4 (1160-1490)","5z5k_A  DCC Ig1-4",1.380e-21,23.0),
 ("TSR10-TSR13 (1490-1730)","3t5o_A  complement C6 TSR",1.360e-3,19.3),
 ("PLAC (1715-1762)","2mcr_A  (no real hit)",2.099,34.4)],
 columns=["segment","best_pdb100_hit","evalue","pct_id"])

exo = pd.DataFrame([
 ("R568","A198",0),("K608","E238",0),("M609","N239",0),("R636","K258",1),
 ("L637","F259",0),("R639","D261",0),("R660","S282",0),("Y661","G283",0),
 ("L591","not aligned",-1),("F592","not aligned",-1),("Y665","not aligned",-1),("L668","not aligned",-1)],
 columns=["ADAMTS13_exosite3","ADAMTSL1_equivalent","conserved"])

tsr = pd.DataFrame([
 ("TSR1",2,True),("TSR2",-2,False),("TSR3",-3,False),("TSR4",3,False),("TSR5",-1,False),
 ("TSR6",-3,False),("TSR7",1,False),("TSR8",2,False),("TSR9",1,False),("TSR10",5,False),
 ("TSR11",6,False),("TSR12",-1,False),("TSR13",4,False)], columns=["TSR","net_charge","W_ladder"])
ctrl = pd.DataFrame([("TSP1 TSR2*",2,True),("TSP1 TSR3*",0,True),
                     ("Properdin TSR4*",7,False),("ADAMTS13 TSR1",1,False)],
                    columns=["TSR","net_charge","W_ladder"])

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(15.5,12.5))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3,2,height_ratios=[1.0,1.25,1.25],hspace=0.55,wspace=0.28)

# --- A: domain map coloured by pLDDT -------------------------------------
axA = fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
cmap = plt.get_cmap("RdYlBu")
for _,r in dom.iterrows():
    col = cmap(np.clip((r.pLDDT-40)/50,0,1))
    axA.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((r.start,0.15),r.end-r.start,0.7,facecolor=col,edgecolor="black",lw=0.6))
    if r.end-r.start > 35:
        axA.text((r.start+r.end)/2,0.5,r["name"].replace("ADAMTSL1 dom","L1dom"),ha="center",va="center",
                 fontsize=7,rotation=90 if r.end-r.start<70 else 0)
axA.plot([1,1762],[0.05,0.05],color="grey",lw=1)
axA.set_xlim(0,1790); axA.set_ylim(0,1.05); axA.set_yticks([])
axA.set_xlabel("ADAMTSL1 residue (UniProt Q8N6G6, canonical 1762 aa)")
axA.set_title("A. Domain architecture of the AlphaFold model, shaded by mean pLDDT (blue = high, red = low)",
              fontsize=10,loc="left")
sm = plt.cm.ScalarMappable(cmap=cmap,norm=plt.Normalize(40,90))
fig.colorbar(sm,ax=axA,fraction=0.025,pad=0.01,label="mean pLDDT")
axA.axvspan(29,525,ymin=0.88,ymax=0.98,color="grey",alpha=0.35)
axA.text(277,0.97,"region present in the 525 aa punctin-1 isoform studied biochemically",
         ha="center",va="bottom",fontsize=7)

# --- B: Foldseek best hit per segment ------------------------------------
axB = fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
y = np.arange(len(fs))[::-1]
val = -np.log10(fs.evalue)
cols = ["#2166ac" if v>3 else ("#92c5de" if v>1 else "#d6604d") for v in val]
axB.barh(y,val,color=cols,edgecolor="black",lw=0.5)
axB.set_yticks(y); axB.set_yticklabels(fs.segment,fontsize=8)
for yy,v,h,p in zip(y,val,fs.best_pdb100_hit,fs.pct_id):
    axB.text(max(v,0)+0.4,yy,f"{h}  ({p:.0f}% id)",va="center",fontsize=7)
axB.axvline(3,color="black",ls="--",lw=0.8)
axB.text(3.1,-0.9,"E = 1e-3",fontsize=7)
axB.set_xlim(-0.5,34)
axB.set_xlabel("-log10(Foldseek E-value) of best pdb100 hit")
axB.set_title("B. Best experimental-structure homolog per ADAMTSL1 segment\n(Foldseek 3Di+AA vs pdb100)",
              fontsize=10,loc="left")

# --- C: exosite conservation ---------------------------------------------
axC = fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
y = np.arange(len(exo))[::-1]
colmap = {1:"#2166ac",0:"#d6604d",-1:"#bbbbbb"}
axC.barh(y,[1]*len(exo),color=[colmap[c] for c in exo.conserved],edgecolor="black",lw=0.5)
axC.set_yticks(y); axC.set_yticklabels(exo.ADAMTS13_exosite3,fontsize=8)
for yy,(_,r) in zip(y,exo.iterrows()):
    axC.text(0.03,yy,f"→ {r.ADAMTSL1_equivalent}",va="center",fontsize=8,
             color="white" if r.conserved>=0 else "black")
axC.set_xticks([]); axC.set_xlim(0,1)
axC.set_title("C. ADAMTS13 spacer exosite-3 residues mapped onto ADAMTSL1\nthrough the Foldseek structural alignment (1/8 aligned residues conserved)",
              fontsize=10,loc="left")
axC.legend(handles=[mp.Patch(color="#2166ac",label="conserved"),
                    mp.Patch(color="#d6604d",label="not conserved"),
                    mp.Patch(color="#bbbbbb",label="no structural equivalent")],
           fontsize=7,loc="lower right",frameon=False)

# --- D: TSR net charge ----------------------------------------------------
axD = fig.add_subplot(gs[2,:])
allt = pd.concat([tsr,ctrl],ignore_index=True)
x = np.arange(len(allt))
cols = ["#4393c3"]*len(tsr)+["#b2182b"]*len(ctrl)
bars = axD.bar(x,allt.net_charge,color=cols,edgecolor="black",lw=0.6)
for xi,(_,r) in zip(x,allt.iterrows()):
    if r.W_ladder:
        axD.text(xi,r.net_charge+(0.35 if r.net_charge>=0 else -0.8),"W-ladder",ha="center",fontsize=6.5)
axD.axhline(0,color="black",lw=0.8)
axD.set_xticks(x); axD.set_xticklabels(allt.TSR,rotation=45,ha="right",fontsize=8)
axD.set_ylabel("net charge (K+R) - (D+E)")
axD.set_title("D. Net charge and W-x-x-W-x-x-W tryptophan ladder of each ADAMTSL1 TSR (blue) vs reference TSRs (red).\n* = TSRs with documented heparin binding in thrombospondin-1. Only ADAMTSL1 TSR1 keeps the ladder; TSR10/11/13 are the most basic.",
              fontsize=10,loc="left")
axD.set_ylim(-5,8.5)
plt.show()

print(fs.to_string(index=False))
print()
print(exo.to_string(index=False))
